verdict.rationale: Bland documents post-call webhooks, which are HTTP notifications it automatically sends to your server when a call completes. That is a genuine outbound callback a programmatic consumer can receive. Pathways can also execute webhooks mid-conversation, and JWT signatures let receivers verify incoming requests. Missing for 10: a documented catalog of subscribable event types beyond call completion, registration/retry/delivery details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
